title: Identification of compounds that repress DUX4 expression in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy.
authors: Chang, Ning; Moore, Hannah P; Himeda, Charis L; O'Brien, Terrence E; Thomas, William; Roshanravan, Baback; Jones, Takako I; Jones, Peter L
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI筛选抑制DUX4表达的小分子化合物，虽涉及转录因子DUX4但核心是药物发现，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) is caused by epigenetic dysregulation of the disease locus, leading to pathogenic misexpression of DUX4 in skeletal muscle. Thus, most FSHD therapeutic approaches target DUX4. Our previous study identified the chromatin remodeling factor BAZ1A (bromodomain adjacent to zinc finger domain protein 1A) as a promising target for therapeutic development. Here we used an artificial intelligence-based screening pipeline to identify molecules predicted to bind the BAZ1A bromodomain, and validated hit compounds using FSHD-specific assays in FSHD myocytes. One compound, termed C06, emerged as a potent repressor of DUX4 and DUX4 target gene expression. Interestingly, while C06 exhibited binding to BAZ1A in vitro, it can also inhibit multiple kinases, including p38alpha, an upstream activator of DUX4. Despite this, at low doses C06 was an equally effective and more specific repressor of DUX4 than losmapimod, which is a robust and specific p38 inhibitor. At low concentrations, C06 returns the DUX4 gene expression signature to a healthier profile without major effects on the muscle transcriptome. Thus, C06 is a useful tool for potent and specific DUX4 suppression, and a viable candidate for further development. Our results highlight both the utility and limitations of AI for targeted drug discovery, and the importance of using an FSHD-specific functional screening strategy for selecting relevant candidates.
abstract_zh: 面肩肱型肌营养不良症（FSHD）由疾病位点的表观遗传失调引起，导致骨骼肌中DUX4的致病性异常表达。因此，大多数FSHD治疗策略以DUX4为靶点。我们先前的研究将染色质重塑因子BAZ1A（锌指结构域旁溴结构域蛋白1A）确定为具有治疗开发潜力的靶点。在此，我们利用基于人工智能的筛选流程来识别预测能与BAZ1A溴结构域结合的分子，并通过FSHD肌细胞中的FSHD特异性检测验证了命中化合物。其中一种名为C06的化合物，成为DUX4及DUX4靶基因表达的强效抑制因子。有趣的是，尽管C06在体外表现出与BAZ1A的结合能力，它也能抑制多种激酶，包括p38α——DUX4的上游激活因子。尽管如此，在低剂量下，C06对DUX4的抑制效果与losmapimod（一种强效且特异性的p38抑制剂）相当，且更具特异性。在低浓度下，C06将DUX4基因表达特征恢复至更健康的谱型，而对肌肉转录组无显著影响。因此，C06是强效且特异性抑制DUX4的有用工具，也是进一步开发的可行候选药物。我们的结果既凸显了人工智能在靶向药物发现中的实用性及其局限性，也强调了采用FSHD特异性功能筛选策略以选择相关候选药物的重要性。
